title: NexusStrategyGenerateRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/generate, and the input contract of the `nexus.strategy.generate` agent tool. `request` is the GenerateRequest contract (D8): the pattern-package/IR subset a caller may declare, and nothing else — node declarations, edges, nest bindings and the meta fields semantic validation reads. It carries no executable code and no flag that bypasses lint, so a request can only ask for a document; whether that document is legal is decided by lint, never by the caller. The path `strategy_id` is authoritative and is not repeated in the body.

base_revision.description: Candidate revision the caller last read. The kernel commits `base_revision + 1`, or refuses with `strategy_candidate_conflict` and writes nothing — the same compare-and-swap Compose uses.

request.title: GenerateRequest
request.description: The document to generate. Every node, edge and nest is the caller's; nothing is invented. The effect rollup is derived from the bytes under lint, never trusted from this object.
